meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会持续监控一个 Pull Request（PR），反复检查评论、审查线程和 CI 状态，直到所有问题都解决、检查通过、可以合并为止。它会主动修复代码中的实际问题，并推动 PR 达到可合并状态。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 去“照看”、“监控”或“持续检查”某个 PR 的评论、审查和 CI，直到所有可操作的问题都解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我照看这个 PR #42，直到可以合并。
say.note: Claude 会开始监控该 PR 的状态。

say.text: 监控 PR #123 的审查和 CI，有问题就修复。
say.note: Claude 会持续检查并修复问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will continuously monitor a Pull Request (PR), repeatedly checking comments, review threads, and CI status until all issues are resolved, checks pass, and it is ready to merge. It will actively fix real issues in the code and push the PR toward a mergeable state.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to 'babysit', 'monitor', or 'keep checking' a PR's comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #42 until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: Claude will start monitoring the PR status.

say_en.text: Monitor PR #123's reviews and CI, fix issues as they come.
say_en.note: Claude will continuously check and fix problems.
